text:
cheng: Heads-up — ap-south1 scratchpool hit a sudden IOPS floor ~20m ago, GPU provisioning started preempting. Observed more evicts and failed attaches. Anyone on this?

toni: Seen. Can you paste iostat/top of affected node? Is this limited to a single host or whole pool? :warning:

cheng: quick iostat from one host (samples)

```
Device: rrqm/s wrqm/s r/s w/s rsec/s wsec/s  rkB/s  wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await  r_await w_await  svctm  %util
nvme0n1:   0.00  200.00  5.00 1200.00  400.00 96000.00  3200.00 76800.00  64.00   12.34   9.12   10.20  5.00   48.00
```

cheng: avgqu is spiking and %util near 50-60 across several hosts in pool. dmesg shows occasional failed submit_io entries.

alex: this screams janitor/ephemeral cleaner overlap plus a heavy model cache warmup. We saw fstrim backlog earlier: `fstrim -v` reported large reclaim on several nodes.

margo: I just looked — cleaner cadence was bumped yesterday for cost reasons, new cadence may be colliding with nightly model preloads. We should pause janitor until we stabilize. Also cost note: if we split pool into hot/cold it will add reserved capacity overhead :money_with_wings:

oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260323-47 created for ap-south1 IOPS floor. Pager oncall: toni

toni: pausing janitor now for affected host set, increasing iops_quota to temporary 2x for hot pool. Can someone confirm GPU attach backfills?

cheng: confirmed — after pausing janitor and bumping quotas, GPU provisioning resumed and backfill rate looks normal. Attaches succeeded ~15 mins after mitigation. :thumbsup:

alex: short-term ok. For next steps: (1) schedule a pool-split experiment (hot model-cache pool + cold cleaner pool) (2) add smarter janitor backoff if model cache warming is detected (3) run fstrim staggered windows, not simultaneous

margo: Agreed. I'll open a follow-up ticket to quantify cost delta for pool-split and propose an autoscale rule for hot pool. Assigning to infra-storage and runtime teams.

toni: captured. Will keep incident open until we have a canary plan. Thanks all.
